name: @adamancyzhang/agent-java-debugger
description: ajd — a JDWP CLI debugger for remote JVMs: source-mapped breakpoints (global/thread-level/conditional), line stepping, in-memory inspection, gql triggering, agent-friendly JSON output. Zero Python dependencies; requires Python >= 3.10 on the machine that runs the CLI (the debugged JVM can be anywhere).
